mandatoryCriteria: Voluntary departure: Active project manager, member, or viewer can leave their granted project via POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/leave
Owner protection: Workspace owner cannot leave their workspace project (returns 403 FORBIDDEN; must transfer workspace ownership)
Outsider rejection: User without active grant on the project receives 404 NOT_FOUND
Status transition: Updates project_memberships.status to 'removed' and increments version atomically
Immediate access cut-off: Subsequent requests by the departed user to project resources immediately return 404 NOT_FOUND
Historical attribution preserved: Existing card assignments, authored comments, and audit trails remain intact
Idempotency support: Repeated leave calls replay safely without error
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/leave endpoint, voluntary exit authorization, owner prevention, status transitions to 'removed', and immediate access revocation on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Workspace ownership transfer is handled under S6 / ACC-05.
